mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the current temperature is 73 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. We are currently experiencing a waning crescent moon phase. The overnight low will reach 59 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Regarding city news, road construction updates indicate that phase two of the Aldi development project begins the week of September 7th, which will shift traffic patterns on Highway M. Additionally, the Verona Police Department announced the arrest of a Madison woman on September 4th following an investigation into an incident from 2019.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Looking ahead, next week is packed with events including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and more.
The Verona Police Department provided a weekly update regarding an arrest made on Friday, September 4th, related to a sexual assault of a child case that was reported on Sunday, August 30th.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight.
